    pPr = p.getElementsByTagName('w:pPr')

        st = pPr[0].getElementsByTagName('w:pStyle')

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.codex/skills/docx')
from scripts.document import Document, DocxXMLEditor

doc = Document('unpacked', rsid='877FF1E8', author='Claude', track_revisions=True)
editor = doc['word/document.xml']
body = editor.dom.getElementsByTagName('w:body')[0]
paras = body.getElementsByTagName('w:p')

def ptext(p):
    return ''.join(t.firstChild.data if t.firstChild else '' for t in p.getElementsByTagName('w:t'))

def pstyle(p):
    pPr = p.getElementsByTagName('w:pPr')
    if pPr:
        st = pPr[0].getElementsByTagName('w:pStyle')
        if st:
            return st[0].getAttribute('w:val')
    return ''

used = {}
for p in paras:
    s = pstyle(p)
    used[s] = used.get(s, 0) + 1
print('style usage:', used)
print('first:', [(pstyle(p), ptext(p)[:80]) for p in paras[:5]])
print('last:', [(pstyle(p), ptext(p)[:80]) for p in paras[-5:]])

heading = 'Heading1' if used.get('Heading1') else next(iter(used), 'Heading1')
print('heading style:', heading)

anchor = paras[-1]
items = [
    '<w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="' + heading + '"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Recommendations</w:t></w:r></w:p>',
    '<w:p><w:r><w:t>Based on the results discussed above, we recommend the following actions for the coming quarter:</w:t></w:r></w:p>',
    '<w:p><w:r><w:t>1. Continue investing in the initiatives that delivered the strongest performance this quarter.</w:t></w:r></w:p>',
    '<w:p><w:r><w:t>2. Address weaker areas by adjusting resource allocation and execution plans.</w:t></w:r></w:p>',
    '<w:p><w:r><w:t>3. Monitor emerging risks closely and update forecasts as conditions change.</w:t></w:r></w:p>',
]
for xml in items:
    tracked = DocxXMLEditor.suggest_paragraph(xml)
    nodes = editor.insert_after(anchor, tracked)
    anchor = nodes[-1]

doc.save()
print('saved')
